audit_item:
- Check for the presence of the safety cable and shackle.
- Ensure all mounting bolts are present and torqued to 40ft.lb (54.2 N-m)
- Inspect motor terminations inside the motor junction box and tighten if necessary.
- Check the gear reducer for oil leakage. 
- Ensure all 16 bolts securing the airfoils to the fan are present and torqued 29 ft-lb (39.3 N-m)
- Ensure airfoils are secured to one another by airfoils retainers.
- Ensure the bolts securing the winglets to the airfoils are securely tightened.
- Inspect the airfoils and hub for signs of damage or cracks.
- Check guy wires for fraying or damage.
